entries.subject: DAMIT 4390: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 4390, version 2020-01-28, pole (132°, -86°), period 6.53679 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 0.448 ± 0.02 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived radar and light-curve model. DAMIT marks model 4390 as size-calibrated (D = 0.448 km, σ = 0.02 km); radar delay-Doppler images fix the scale. NEOWISE lists 0.451 ± 0.026 km (JPL SBDB), consistent within the quoted error.
